source.verification: Author checked hash/source and rendered boundaries. Main independently verified all16 term/page matches, actual boundaries, cue economy and reuse. Source establishes vocabulary location only, not clinical guidance or recall effectiveness.

scope: Sixteen selected reusable vocabulary terms, not exhaustive chapter coverage. Offline candidate associations only, not clinical anchors, lessons, narration or image-generation prompts. New chapter records and compositions are not claims of novel invention or validated recall.

source_wording_notes.wheals: Exact plural in urticaria body on printed71; plural wheel composition reuses the established singular wheal/wheel bridge.
source_wording_notes.sulfa: Exact standalone family word in left-column body on printed73, not an inferred substring of sulfamethoxazole. Family identity only.
source_wording_notes.urticaria: Exact heading and body on printed71. Proposed broad skin-category cue is not the held hives/beehives workshop attempt. That historical hold is not resolved here.
